purpose: Nothing to show yet: an icon, a title saying what is empty, one sentence on why, and the action that fills it.

props.name: variant
props.description: inline (default) sits inside a section with an h2; page fills the screen and owns the h1

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon for the kind of content

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short line above the title, such as an error code

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence on why it is empty or what goes here

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The action that fills the space

whenToUse: A list, table or page with no content yet, or no results
whenNotToUse: Errors that stop the whole page — use ErrorPage
antiPatterns: An empty state with no action
Blaming the user for the empty state

sizes: Body up to `size-container-sm`; gaps `space-component-gap-md`; inline padding `space-layout-section`
typography: Title h1 (page) or h3 appearance (inline); description body 1 secondary

a11yNotes: page is the main landmark with an h1; inline uses an h2 inside its section

slots.name: title
slots.description: Says what is empty. Example: No invoices yet.

slots.name: description
slots.description: One sentence. Example: Invoices you send appear here.

slots.name: primaryAction
slots.description: The action that fills it. Example: Create invoice.
